answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with seizable sponsor vouchers: a new identity joins only when an established agent stakes a voucher on it, like a reef sheltering a newcomer — if the newcomer cheats, the sponsor voucher is slashed. In a tundra of anonymous accounts, trust must be lent, not claimed. Cloning a thousand identities means finding a thousand sponsors willing to risk their own stake, and a single comet of fraud burns the sponsor too, so the attacker cost scales with every fake identity.
